name: caretrail
description: CARETRAIL — offline-first community healthcare navigation, referral and follow-up platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @caretrail/shared-types && npm run build -w @caretrail/validation && npm run build -w @caretrail/api-client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @caretrail/api && npm run build -w @caretrail/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @caretrail/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @caretrail/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @caretrail/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
